question: Select the sentence with no spelling errors.

options.text: At the end of my five-day experiment, I created a spredsheet of my results, with each group getting its own column.
At the end of my five-day experiment, I created a spredsheet of my results, with each group getting its own column.
At the end of my five-day experement, I created a spreadsheet of my results, with each group getting its own column.
At the end of my five-day experiment, I created a spreadsheet of my results, with each group getting its own column.

solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"experiment"** means a scientific procedure undertaken to make a discovery, test a hypothesis, or demonstrate a known fact. (प्रयोग)

 
 
• **Example: **The students conducted an **experiment** to test the effect of sunlight on plant growth.
 
 
 
• **"Spreadsheet"** refers to an electronic document in which data is arranged in rows and columns, often used for calculations. (स्प्रेडशीट)
 
 
• **Example: **She used a** spreadsheet** to organize her monthly budget.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Spredsheet** (स्प्रेडशीट): This is a misspelling of "spreadsheet."

 
 
• **Example:** Incorrect: He used a spredsheet to keep track of his expenses. Correct: He used a spreadsheet to keep track of his expenses.
 
 
 
• **Experement** (प्रयोग): This is a misspelling of "experiment."
 
 
• **Example: **Incorrect: They conducted an experement in the laboratory. Correct: They conducted an experiment in the laboratory.
